verdict.rationale: Bento documents first-party SDKs/packages (JS, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, Next.js), a ClickFunnels integration, and generic outbound webhooks to trigger external systems — enough for ops users to wire up e-commerce and custom stacks. However, there is no evidence of maintained first-party integrations specifically named in the story (Stripe, Shopify, or a CDP like Segment); WooCommerce covers e-commerce but not Shopify directly, and webhooks are generic rather than pre-built connectors. Missing for 10: explicit Stripe integration, explicit Shopify integration, explicit Segment/CDP integration, and any direct database connector.
